description:
Search stored awards by buyer, CPV, keywords and buyer region.


A named profile filters cached awards as well as optional refresh. Explicit CPV, exclusion,
keyword and region arguments override that profile's corresponding fields, including empty lists.
Contract notice types and submission deadline rules do not constrain historical awards.
The result lists one latest award per procedure and lot, with its source notice.
By default (compact=true) each source notice is listed once in notices and its awards keep only source
and number, without empty fields; compact=false repeats notice fields on every award.
summary counts every filtered award, not just the page: awards (lot results), distinct procedures,
notices, buyers and contractors, status counts, missing price/contractor/date/bid count, bid count
statistics, and per-currency sum/min/median/max of lot prices. Prices that cover several lots
(price_scope notice_total) or a framework ceiling, or whose scope is unknown, are left out of the sums
and counted in prices_left_out. limit=0 returns only the summary.
With keywords_any each award has keyword_scope: lot when a term is in its lot's title or description (taken
from any stored notice of the procedure, usually the contract notice) or the notice has a single lot;
notice when the lot is described and the terms matched only elsewhere, which does not show this lot is the
same product; unknown when no stored notice names or describes the lot.
coverage describes acquisition windows and scopes per source, independently of result counts.

compact.description: Return a smaller response: each notice once, no empty fields. Same awards and totals.
compact.title: Compact

cpv.description: CPV codes or prefixes ending in *, e.g. ["33600000", "72*"]. A notice matches if any code matches.
cpv.title: Cpv

end.description: Last publication date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.
end.title: End

exclude_cpv.description: CPV codes or prefixes ending in * to ignore; a notice whose every code is excluded is left out.
exclude_cpv.title: Exclude Cpv

exclude_keywords.description: Words that exclude a notice when they match, with the same matching rules as keywords_any.
exclude_keywords.title: Exclude Keywords

keywords_any.description: Words matched at word starts in titles, descriptions and lot titles; any one is enough. Use *term* for a substring anywhere in a word.
keywords_any.title: Keywords Any

keywords_in_lot.description: Only awards with keyword_scope lot: a keywords_any term in the lot title or description (any field for single-lot notices).
keywords_in_lot.title: Keywords In Lot

limit.description: Maximum number of awards to return, 0-500; 0 returns only the summary.
limit.title: Limit

max_offers.description: Only lots with at most this many bids, e.g. 1 for single-bid lots; lots without a bid count are left out.
max_offers.title: Max Offers

min_offers.description: Only lots with at least this many bids; lots without a bid count are left out.
min_offers.title: Min Offers

offset.description: Number of items to skip for paging, 0-20000.
offset.title: Offset

profile.description: Filter awards with this configured profile; explicit filters override its fields. Required for refresh.
profile.title: Profile

regions.description: Buyer voivodeships by Polish name ("mazowieckie") or TERYT code ("14").
regions.title: Regions

sort.description: Order awards by lot price, award date, notice publication date or bid count; "-" for descending. Awards without the value come last.
sort.title: Sort

start.description: First publication date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.
start.title: Start

status.description: Only awarded or only cancelled lots.
status.title: Status

name: search_results
title: Search awards
